queries:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference
FROM order_counts AS oc
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id
LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    ranked.account_id,
    district.A3 AS region,
    ranked.order_count,
    ranked.difference
FROM ranked
JOIN account ON account.account_id = ranked.account_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE ranked.order_rank <= 10
ORDER BY ranked.difference DESC, ranked.account_id;

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS count_rank
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    r.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    r.order_count,
    r.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference
FROM ranked_accounts AS r
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE r.count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY difference DESC, r.account_id

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_orders AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - av.avg_order_count AS difference
FROM order_counts AS oc
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN avg_orders AS av
WHERE oc.order_count > av.avg_order_count
ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id
LIMIT 10
